thanks_suffix: for their groundwork and ongoing contributions.
select_topic_prompt: Please select the type of issue you want to report
create_topic_summary: Create a new subtopic for TUM SafeSignal:
summary_hint: Markdown formatting is supported (e.g. **bold**, *italic*, lists, [links](https://example.org)). Colours: {green}text{/green} – also red, yellow, blue, grey.
admins_desc: Can edit this topic, see and reply to reports and add other admins.
emailDescription: If you want to be informed about updates to this report, please enter your E-Mail address.
notification_channels_desc: Where a new or updated report on this topic is announced. Several channels can be combined.
webhook_url_desc: Optional. HTTPS endpoint that receives a content-free ping (id + link) on every report.
otrs_enable: Create an OTRS ticket for reports
otrs_queue_desc: Leave empty to use the globally configured default queue (MELDE_OTRS_QUEUE).
title: Title
about_text: TUM SafeSignal is the reporting platform of the Technical University of Munich. Members and guests of the university can use it to report problems, misconduct, safety concerns, or other issues to the team responsible for handling them. Pick a topic below, fill in a short form, and your report goes straight to the right people.
intro_text: Your report reaches the responsible TUM teams – confidentially, anonymously if you wish, and without an account.
no_topics_configured: No reporting topics have been configured yet.
report_closed_no_reply: This report is closed. You can no longer reply to it.
overdue_summary: {1} :count report needs attention (overdue)|[2,*] :count reports need attention (overdue)
please_fix_errors: Please fix the highlighted fields and submit again.
upload_image_unreadable: This image could not be processed, so we could not remove its metadata (e.g. GPS/EXIF). Rather than upload it unprotected, please re-save or convert it and try again.
upload_metadata_warning: Note: image metadata (e.g. GPS/EXIF) is stripped on upload. Documents (PDF, Office) and the file name itself may still reveal your identity — please remove such details beforehand.
receipt_heading: Your access code – write it down now
receipt_instructions: Write down this code and keep it somewhere safe. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved again.
receipt_track_hint: With this code you can return to your report anonymously at any time via the “Track report” page.
track_link: Already have a report? Track it
track_intro: Enter the access code you received when you submitted your report.
track_not_found: No report could be found for this code. Please check your input.
no_reports_yet: No reports yet across the topics you manage.
confirm_close_bulk: Mark the selected reports as closed?
confirm_spam_bulk: Mark the selected reports as spam?
draft_restored: We restored your previous draft on this device. File selections were not saved.
users_intro: Promote users to global admin, pre-assign topic access, and revoke privileges.
users_global_env_hint: Granted by MELDE_ADMIN_USERS env config; revoke there.
users_cannot_self_demote: You cannot demote yourself from global admin via this UI.
users_cannot_set_global_admin_pending: Global admin can only be granted to users who have already logged in. Assign topic access first.
dashboard_no_matches: No reports match the current filters.
audio_hint: Record a voice message directly, or upload an audio file.
require_login_desc: Reporters must authenticate with their TUM login. Their identity is recorded automatically.
retention_days_desc: Automatically delete closed reports under this topic this many days after they were concluded (Done/Spam). Open reports are never auto-deleted. Leave empty to use the system default.
login_required_identity_note: Your identity will be associated with this report.
validation_topic_name_required: Provide a topic name in at least one language.
validation_field_name_required: Provide a field name in at least one language.
validation_field_text_required: Provide the text in at least one language.
audit_intro: Tamper-evident record of security-relevant administrator actions.
topics_admin_intro: Manage topics: activate, deactivate, and delete empty topics.
topic_confirm_deactivate: Deactivate topic “:name”? It will stop accepting new reports and be hidden from the public list. Existing reports are kept.
topic_confirm_delete: Permanently delete topic “:name”? This cannot be undone.
topic_delete_blocked: Topics with existing reports cannot be deleted. Deactivate the topic instead.
topic_delete_disabled_hint: Cannot delete while reports exist. Deactivate the topic instead.
confirm_bulk: Apply this action to the selected topics?
